title: 3-Ingredient Protein Cheesecake
description: Just 3 ingredients — flavoured Greek yogurt, an egg and pudding powder — baked into a creamy personal cheesecake.

ingredients.text: 25g sweetener (if yogurt is not sweet enough)

steps: Mix yogurt, egg and pudding powder until smooth. Add sweetener if needed.
Line a 15cm (6in) baking dish with parchment paper; pour in batter.
Bake 30–35 minutes. Cool 15 minutes; refrigerate 1 hour or overnight.
notes: Try strawberry yogurt + vanilla pudding or vice versa. Top with powdered peanuts.
